snippet.title: Grade 10 Physical Sciences: Motion in One Dimension
snippet.description:
A focused CAPS-grounded lesson on reference frames, distance, displacement, velocity, acceleration and motion graphs for Grade 10 Physical Sciences Term 3.

This lesson accompanies the HOMS Learning Studio one-topic companion. The pack includes a concept guide, practical activity, worksheet, mini-assessment and memoranda. Educator or subject-expert review is required before classroom use.
